analysis.summary: Akiko Global Services Limited reported healthy growth in Q1 FY27, driven by core business expansion and the development of its digital platform, AkikoPay. Management expressed strong confidence in achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of INR 325 crore to INR 350 crore. The company is transitioning into a hybrid model by integrating its offline distribution network with digital financial services. Management also confirmed plans to scale its branch network and maintain profitability while avoiding unnecessary expenses. Akiko Global Services Limited reported strong Q1 FY27 performance, characterized by significant revenue growth and healthy profitability.

guidance.claim: Management revised its FY27 revenue guidance to INR 325 crore to INR 350 crore.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects a PAT margin of 9% to 11% for the current year.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

guidance.claim: Management targets a CAGR of 70% to 100% over the next three years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve revenue of ₹300–325 crore for FY27.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: The company targets revenue growth of 70% to 100% for FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue of INR 50 crores to INR 100 crores from AkikoPay in FY27.
guidance.quote: From AkikoPay, I am expecting revenue in the first quarter because AkikoPay is properly indulged with our core business. If seen, I am expecting AkikoPay revenue of INR50 crores to INR100 crores in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company has a long-term vision to reach INR 1,000 crores in revenue by 2030 with PAT margins of 12% to 13%.
guidance.quote: We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q1 FY27 revenue to be between INR 65 crores and INR 70 crores.
guidance.quote: I am expecting INR65 crores to something in between crores in Q1.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's core business and distribution are growing month-on-month by 4% to 7%.
demand_outlook.quote: So, we highly value everyone's trust. Many investors place great trust in us and we will continue to work with full commitment going forward. Whatever commitment we make, we will fulfill it. So thank you everyone, and I would now be happy to take your questions.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to reach a total of 25 branches this year.
capex_expansion.quote: There is a plan for 25 branches in total.

capex_expansion.claim: New branches are planned for Indore and Kerala in the next 2-3 months.
capex_expansion.quote: Over the next 2-3 months, a couple of more branches are lined up, with one opening in Indore and one towards Kerala.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has expanded its physical branch presence to multiple cities including Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore, and others.
capex_expansion.quote: Along with this, we have also expanded our company-owned branch presence in multiple cities. Like Delhi NCR is known to everyone, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Lucknow, Kolkata, Patna, and many emerging markets.

margins_costs.claim: The company aims to maintain profitable growth and avoid unnecessary expenses on AkikoPay.
margins_costs.quote: We will not incur any unnecessary expenses on AkikoPay.

margins_costs.claim: AkikoPay benefits from a 40% lower customer acquisition cost compared to traditional channels.
margins_costs.quote: ~40% lower CAC vs traditional channels, enabled by a lean, digital-first model

margins_costs.claim: Q4 margins were impacted by planned investments in branch expansion and technology infrastructure.
margins_costs.quote: One question many people are asking me is that there has been some pressure on margins in Q4. This was due to our planned investment towards branch expansion, this was the most important thing, in which some of our money has been spent on that.

margins_costs.claim: Dubai operations faced temporary margin pressure due to geopolitical issues.
margins_costs.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

orders_capacity.claim: The company aims to reach 1,000 crore in monthly loan disbursements by the end of Q3.
orders_capacity.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursals have increased to over ₹450 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently disburses over 16,000 credit cards monthly.
orders_capacity.quote: If we talk about the credit card segment, which used to be our core business at one time, today we successfully disburse 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's loan book has reached INR 5,000 crores with a monthly disbursement run rate of over INR 400 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

capital_allocation.claim: There are no plans for fundraising for the next 6 months to 1 year.
capital_allocation.quote: No, sir. There is absolutely no plan for fundraising right now. Even banks are supporting us very well. So, our CC limits are well aligned. So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Dubai business faced revenue pressure in Q1 due to war.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's forward-looking statements are subject to risks including the performance of the Indian economy and competition.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and world-wide, competition, the company’s ability to successfully implement its strategy, the Company’s future levels of growth and expansion, technological implementation, changes and advancements, changes in revenue, income or cash flows, the Company’s market preferences and its exposure to market risks, as well as other risks.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in the Iran region impacted Dubai operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

management_commitments.claim: The company will implement the new Android version of AkikoPay on the Apple App Store within a week.
management_commitments.quote: Customers are also really liking our new Android version and this same version will be implemented on Apple's App Store within a week.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to reach 1,000 crore in monthly loan disbursements by December.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to reduce receivable days to within 90 days in Q2.
management_commitments.quote: In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to roll out the iOS version of AkikoPay in the coming months.
management_commitments.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets FY27 revenue of ₹300–325 crore.
management_commitments.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach 1 million AkikoPay customers by the end of December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: I am expecting 5 lakh customers by 30th of September and 1 million customers till 31st December.

management_commitments.claim: Ankur Gaba will likely take the position of MD in the next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: Most likely in the next one or two months. I have already spoken with my management. They did agreed. So, we'll take a -- we'll take a decision very soon and in the next quarter, you will see me as an MD.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
